verdict.rationale: Ramp's QuickBooks integration documents real-time sync of "accounting fields, transactions, reimbursements, payments..." (ramp-docs-44), and transactions are coded to the correct GL account (ramp-docs-32). NetSuite and Xero integration pages also exist, and departments, tracking categories, and accounting field options are first-class objects (ramp-supp-ai-agents-channels, ramp-docs-68). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that transactions (not just vendor bills) sync to NetSuite and Xero, explicit user-controlled class and department mapping configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
